title: Yummy Crispy Venezuelan Mixed Grain Fried Rice
description: A savory, low-sodium mixed-grain fried rice with chicken, fresh vegetables, and a hint of lime, perfect for a date night.

ingredients.name: cooked mixed grains (brown rice, quinoa, barley)

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Add diced onion, bell pepper, carrot, and minced garlic, sautéing until the vegetables soften, about 4 minutes.
Push the vegetables to the side of the skillet and pour the beaten eggs into the cleared space, scrambling them until just set.
Stir the scrambled eggs into the vegetables, then add the pre‑cooked mixed grains, breaking any clumps with a wooden spoon.
Pour the low‑sodium soy sauce over the grains and mix thoroughly to coat evenly.
Add the cooked chicken and frozen peas, cooking for an additional 3 minutes until the peas thaw and the chicken heats through.
Season with freshly ground black pepper to taste.
Remove the skillet from heat and stir in fresh lime juice for brightness.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and serve immediately.
